run_dns_server_for_lb_interop_tests: run a DNS server for gRPC load balancing interop tests with balancer and fallback IPs
generate_dns_records_config_yaml: generate a YAML config file with DNS A and SRV records for balancer and fallback servers
parse_grpclb_balancer_ips: parse comma-separated gRPC load balancer IP addresses from the --grpclb_ips CLI argument
parse_fallback_server_ips: parse comma-separated fallback server IP addresses from the --fallback_ips CLI argument
simulate_no_error_no_data_dns_response: simulate a DNS NOERROR response with no ANSWER section by inserting a TXT record for the balancer domain
